findings.message: $HOME/koan-root/tree/@7.md is the notes of @7, which was deleted. It is empty, and koan repair removes it.
$HOME/koan-root/tree/@99.md names @99, which was never issued. It holds content, so koan leaves it: keep what you want of it, then remove it.
$HOME/koan-root/tree/@start.md names a start gate the root can't have. It is empty, and koan repair removes it.
$HOME/koan-root/tree/@work/@3.md is the notes of @3, which was deleted. It holds content, so koan leaves it: keep what you want of it, then remove it.
$HOME/koan-root/tree/@work/@api/@4.md is the notes of @4, which was archived to $HOME/koan-root/archived/work/api/@4.md. It is empty, and koan repair removes it.
$HOME/koan-root/tree/@work/@api/@done.md names a done gate its folder doesn't have. It is empty, and koan repair removes it.
